auth.guestLink: Just looking? Explore the map as a guest
auth.footerNote: A personal hobby project. Made for love of the work — no coin sought.
auth.welcomeLine2: Sign in to bring a character to life and set out on your own adventure — or wander the map freely as a guest to explore its lands, search for places, and trace routes.

welcome.intro: This is the Middle-earth Wandering Simulator — a place to breathe life into a character and roam freely, from the shadow of the Misty Mountains to the shores of Lindon.
welcome.souls: Two souls walk these lands for you to inhabit: {aranath}, a Dúnedain ranger resting in Bree, and {celebrian}, an Elf of Lórien dwelling in Cerin Amroth. You may switch between them freely on the map — though be warned, an adventure abandoned cannot be reclaimed.
welcome.credits: A personal hobby and portfolio project, made for love of the work — no coin sought, no rights claimed. Built in respect of J.R.R. Tolkien's legendarium and of MERP (© Iron Crown Enterprises).
welcome.whoseFeet: Whose feet will you walk in?
welcome.chooseCharacter: Choose a character to begin your journey.
welcome.seasonTitle: In what season would you set out?
welcome.seasonSubtitle: Choose the time of year for your journey.

spring.title: Spring
spring.desc: For new green and the long light returning; for those who like to begin.

summer.title: Summer
summer.desc: For warm roads and far horizons; for those who would rather be anywhere but indoors.

autumn.title: Autumn
autumn.desc: For woodsmoke and gold and the turning of the year; for those who love a little melancholy.

winter.title: Winter
winter.desc: For hard frost and clear stars and an empty road; for those who like the cold and the quiet.

options.deleteBody: This will permanently delete your account, characters, and all trip data. This cannot be undone.

phrases.0: Consulting the old maps and the older roads…
phrases.1: Rousing the things that stir in the dark places…
phrases.2: Asking the wind which way the weather turns…
phrases.4: Setting your feet upon the road that goes ever on…

directions.line1: The road calls, but a tale is still being written.
directions.line2: If you set new directions now, your current adventure will be abandoned and lost to the ages.
directions.line3: Are you sure you wish to leave it behind?

switch.line1: A tale is still unfolding for this company.
switch.line2: Switching to another soul will abandon the current adventure. What is written cannot be unwritten.
switch.line3: Do you wish to leave it behind?

season.line1: The seasons turn, but a tale is still being written.
season.line2: Changing the season now will abandon your current adventure. What is written cannot be unwritten.
season.line3: Do you wish to leave it behind?

logout.title: Take your leave?
logout.line1: The road goes ever on, but your tale will rest here.
logout.line2: Signing out will return you to the gates of the realm.
logout.line3: Are you sure you wish to depart?

deathModal.title: The Journey Ends Here
deathModal.body: The road goes ever on — but not for them. Their tale is told, their steps recorded. The adventure is now preserved.
